system.description:
The hostile and arid desert reaches from which these lizards hail have made them formidable adversaries. Beware their natural defenses.

Arid Scales

Deal Poison damage equal to your Naturecraft to a melee attacker when you Defend (1/encounter). [M]

+1 Naturecraft. [A]

Nim+ Volume I — submitted by Kazok the Goblin, Theleftmouseknop, Raford.
